children: Temasek-backed Shiprocket on Monday posted a narrower loss in its first quarterly earnings report since listing.
The logistics services firm posted consolidated loss of 137.1 million rupees ($1.45 million) for the quarter ended June 30, from loss of 180.3 million rupees a year ago.
